name: Sonneck
beschreibung:
Overview

Haus Sonneck is a holiday house at Liss 13 in Jerzens (6474) in the Pitztal, district of Imst. It is located directly at the valley station of the Hochzeigerbahn, so that guests can practically see the chairs of the lift right outside the door. The house is rented out by the Lentsch family, who also run the neighbouring sports shop Sport Lentsch with rental, service and ski school. On its own website, the house is described as a holiday home for families and groups of friends; in the Pitztal tourism portal it is categorised as a holiday house or holiday apartment. The accommodation is designed for self-catering and offers space for groups.

History/Background

According to the Pitztal accommodation directory, Haus Sonneck is a former hotel that is now rented out as a comfortable group house and holiday home for 6 to 39 people. The building comprises 19 rooms and around 450 m² of living space over three floors. Two spacious dining rooms with rustic wooden beam ceilings as well as an in-house parlour with a bar are part of the accommodation. The provider is Sport Lentsch GmbH.

Getting there

The accommodation is located in the village of Liss in Jerzens in the Pitztal. According to the Pitztal Tourist Board, arrival and departure by bus are free of charge, using the mobile guest card. The house directly adjoins the valley station area of the Hochzeigerbahn; the sports shop Sport Lentsch with rental, service and ski school is right next door.

Tips

Those arriving in winter benefit from the location directly at the lift: skis and equipment can be stored in the existing drying and storage room, and next door Sport Lentsch offers a heated ski depot directly on the slope. Cooking is done as self-catering in the private kitchen. For summer stays there is the Pitztal Summer Card as a purchase card, with which mountain railways and attractions in the valley can be flexibly added. Around Jerzens, hiking, biking and the family-friendly ZirbenPark on the Hochzeiger invite you to explore. The accommodation is a partner business of the Pitztal Ski Inclusive Weeks from 4 to 20 December 2026. According to the accommodation directory, electricity is charged separately on site. Enquiries are easiest by email or telephone.

Best time to travel

Haus Sonneck is described as a two-season base: in winter, skiing and winter hiking around the Hochzeiger are the focus; in summer, hiking, biking and the ZirbenPark. If you would like to use the Ski Inclusive Weeks, you can plan for the period from 4 to 20 December 2026.
